## Release checklist

- [ ] Every issue in the `vX.Y.Z` milestone is closed (or moved to the next milestone)
- [ ] "Included changes" regenerated after the last merge
- [ ] Deployment notes reviewed and consolidated above
- [ ] CI is green on `release/vX.Y.Z`
- [ ] Docs up to date (see `docs/documentation.md`)
- [ ] Version bumped where the project records it
- [ ] Release branch tested end-to-end

**After merging** (merge commit, not squash):

- [ ] Tag the release: `git tag -a vX.Y.Z -m "vX.Y.Z" && git push origin vX.Y.Z`
- [ ] Create a GitHub release from the tag using this PR's summary and changes
- [ ] Close the `vX.Y.Z` milestone
- [ ] Set `release.current` in `.claude/workflow.json` to the next version and run `/structured:workflow-init` to create its milestone and branch
